descriptionByLocale.it:
ANYbotics è una società tecnologica in rapida crescita dedicata a modellare il futuro della robotica mobile in più settori. Unisciti al nostro team altamente talentuoso e motivato di oltre 190 persone e lavorare sulla tecnologia robot all'avanguardia. Siamo aperti agli stage tutto l'anno e post regolarmente.

Siamo sempre alla ricerca di stagisti appassionati, curiosi e motivati per unirsi alla nostra missione.

Questa è la tua occasione per collaborare con esperti di livello mondiale, acquisire esperienza nel mondo reale, e dare contributi significativi in un ambiente veloce e interdisciplinare.

Siamo sempre alla ricerca di stagisti appassionati, curiosi e motivati per unirsi al team Advanced Technology. Esploriamo le tecnologie emergenti e le trasformiamo in innovazioni pratiche che modellano il futuro della robotica in ANYbotics. Colpiamo la ricerca all'avanguardia con applicazioni industriali del mondo reale, convalidando rapidamente nuove idee, costruendo prototipi e trasferendo tecnologie di successo nei nostri prodotti. Lavorando a stretto contatto con le principali università, startup e team di ingegneria interna, affrontiamo problemi impegnativi in robotica, intelligenza informatica, e sistemi autonomi per creare la prossima generazione di robot di ispezione industriale.

L'opportunità

Stiamo cercando un Apprendimento di Rinforzamento per lo stage di Navigazione Robotica per unire il nostro team di Tecnologia avanzata e contribuire a migliorare le capacità di mobilità di ANYmal. Utilizzando le più recenti tecniche di apprendimento del rinforzo e strumenti di simulazione, definiamo, formiamo e integriamo i modelli ML in ANYmal per navigare in ambienti industriali in modo sicuro e robusto.

Il tuo ruolo include la valutazione e la messa a punto delle politiche di navigazione e locomozione basate su RL in simulazione e su veri robot quadruped. Questo tirocinio offre un'opportunità profonda ed efficace per lavorare all'avanguardia nell'apprendimento delle macchine nella robotica, giocando un ruolo significativo nella modellazione delle capacità autonome di ANYmal e contribuendo alle applicazioni del mondo reale.

Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con gli esperti di Robotics e partner di ricerca che vi fornirà guida e mentorship. La data di partenza preferita è il settembre 2026 , e lo stage a tempo pieno pagato dura sei mesi.

I tuoi contributi

• Supporto del progetto: lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri ingegneri e ricercatori su progetti attivi in tutto lo stack del software, dal software di applicazione allo stack di autonomia e software a basso livello.

• Algoritmo Attuazione: Progettazione, implementare, testare e convalidare nuovi algoritmi e funzionalità nelle aree software di base.

• Testing & Infrastructure: Contribuisci al continuo miglioramento delle nostre infrastrutture di test, degli ambienti di simulazione e delle tubazioni CI/CD per garantire la robustezza e l'affidabilità della piattaforma ANYmal

• Code Development & Testing: Scrivere codice C++ e Python pulito, efficiente e ben documentato per il funzionamento in tempo reale sul robot. Contribuisci alla nostra robusta infrastruttura di test e simulazione

Il tuo profilo

• Istruzione: Attualmente iscritta in un Bachelor, Masters, o PhD programma in Robotics, Informatica, Ingegneria Elettrica / Meccanica, Meccatronica, o un campo tecnico correlato.

• Conoscenza Fondamentale: solida conoscenza accademica e comprovata capacità in una o più aree rilevanti per la robotica mobile, come Teoria di Controllo, Apprendimento Macchina, Visione Informatica.

• Competenze di programmazione: Forte competenza in Python e/o C++ (il moderno C++ è molto apprezzato).

• Competenze di sviluppo software: Esperienza con strumenti di sviluppo software Git, Docker e AI (ad esempio, Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).

• Collaborazione: Ottima capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente nel nostro ambiente altamente interdisciplinare e di lingua inglese.

• Atteggiamento: Un atteggiamento pratico, proattivo e analitico verso la soluzione di problemi complessi e l'ansia di imparare rapidamente.

Punti bonus, alcune cose in più che ci renderebbero particolarmente eccitati per la vostra applicazione

• Hai addestrato i modelli AI sulle GPU e hai esplorato CUDA o altri framework di calcolo accelerati dalla GPU.

• Passi il weekend a automatizzare i tuoi flussi di lavoro con l'Agenteic AI.

• Conosci e lavora con Robotics Middleware (ROS/ROS 2).

Interessante? Invia la tua richiesta

Vi contatteremo se le vostre competenze e la vostra esperienza sono una buona misura per il team e il ruolo. Si prega di notare a causa dell'alto carico di applicazioni che contatteremo solo quelli che sono rilevanti. Grazie per la vostra comprensione.

Siamo in grado di prendere in considerazione solo le domande dei cittadini Schengen-Area (o di qualsiasi studente iscritto a ETH e EPFL che richiedono uno stage obbligatorio). Per i residenti al di fuori della Svizzera, dovrete trovare il vostro alloggio per richiedere il permesso di lavoro L o B.

Dettagli di stage:

Data di inizio: in qualsiasi momento dell'anno e sempre al 1° del mese

Durata: 6 mesi

Carico di lavoro: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Chi può applicare:

Candidati UE per stage

Lo stage può essere volontario

Un permesso di lavoro non è richiesto, ma il candidato ha bisogno di un permesso di soggiorno

Deve essere iscritto a un'università

Candidati non UE per stage:

Il tirocinio deve essere obbligatorio (supportato da una lettera di un'università)

È richiesto un permesso di lavoro

Deve risiedere in CH

Cosa offriamo:

- Esperienza pratica che lavora sul software avanzato di locomozione.

- Mentorialità da esperti del settore.

- Opportunità di contribuire a progetti innovativi.

- Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e collaborativo.

- Potenziale per future opportunità a tempo pieno.

Vi offriamo un ambiente di lavoro molto emozionante e dinamico, l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di una società in rapida crescita e di un team ambizioso che è in missione di cambiare il mercato dell'ispezione industriale, la possibilità di sfruttare la vostra esperienza e portare le vostre idee, uno stipendio di mercato equo, un ambiente attraente e divertente nella città di Zurigo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.

We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.

This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.

We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join the Advanced Technology team. We explore emerging technologies and transform them into practical innovations that shape the future of robotics at ANYbotics. We bridge cutting-edge research with real-world industrial applications by rapidly validating new ideas, building prototypes, and transferring successful technologies into our products. Working closely with leading universities, startups, and internal engineering teams, we tackle challenging problems in robotics, AI, computer vision, and autonomous systems to create the next generation of industrial inspection robots.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation intern to join our Advanced Technology team and contribute to advancing ANYmal's mobility capabilities. Utilizing the latest reinforcement learning techniques and simulation tools, we define, train, and integrate ML models into ANYmal to safely and robustly navigate challenging industrial environments.

Your role includes evaluating and fine tuning state of the art RL-based navigation & locomotion policies in simulation and on real quadruped robots. This internship provides a profound and impactful opportunity to work at the forefront of machine learning in robotics, playing a significant role in shaping ANYmal's autonomous capabilities and contributing to real-world applications.

You will work closely with Robotics experts and research partners who will provide you with guidance and mentorship. The preferred starting date is September 2026 , and the full-time paid internship lasts six months.

Your Contributions

• Project Support: Work closely with our engineers and researchers on active projects across the entire software stack, from application software to autonomy stack and low-level software.

• Algorithm Implementation: Design, implement, test, and validate new algorithms and features in core software areas.

• Testing & Infrastructure: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing infrastructure, simulation environments, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure the robustness and reliability of the ANYmal platform

• Code Development & Testing: Write clean, efficient, and well-documented C++ and Python code for real-time operation on the robot. Contribute to our robust testing and simulation infrastructure

Your Profile

• Education: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.

• Foundational Knowledge: Solid academic knowledge and proven ability in one or more areas relevant to mobile robotics, such as Control Theory, Machine Learning, Computer Vision.

• Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and/or C++ (Modern C++ is highly valued).

• Software Development Skills: Experience with Git, Docker, and AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).

• Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in our highly interdisciplinary, English-speaking environment.

• Attitude: A hands-on, proactive, and analytical attitude towards complex problem-solving and eagerness to learn rapidly.

Bonus points, a few extra things that would make us especially excited about your application

• You have trained AI models on GPUs and have explored CUDA or other GPU-accelerated computing frameworks.

• You spend your weekends automating your workflows with Agentic AI.

• You know and worked with Robotics Middleware (ROS/ROS 2).

Interested? Submit your application

We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.

We are only able to consider applications from Schengen-Area citizens (or any student enrolled at ETH and EPFL who require compulsory internship). For residents outside of Switzerland, you will have to find your own accommodation in order to apply for the L or B work permit.

Internship Details:

Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month

Duration: 6 months

Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Who can apply:

EU applicants for internships

The internship can be voluntary

A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit

Must be enrolled in a University

Non-EU applicants for internships:

Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)

A work permit is required

Must reside in CH

What We Offer:

- Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.

- Mentorship from industry experts.

- Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.

- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

- Potential for future full-time opportunities.

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.

• Codeentwicklung & Testen: Schreiben Sie sauberen, effizienten und gut dokumentierten C++- und Python-Code für den Echtzeitbetrieb am Roboter. Beitrag zu unserer robusten Test- und Simulationsinfrastruktur

descriptionByLocale.it:
ANYbotics è una società tecnologica in rapida crescita dedicata a modellare il futuro della robotica mobile in più settori. Unisciti al nostro team altamente talentuoso e motivato di oltre 200 persone e lavorare sulla tecnologia robot all'avanguardia. L'opportunità Come VP di System Architecture, definirete la direzione architettonica per la prossima generazione di piattaforme robot ANYbotics. Potrai modellare come una fondazione modulare condivisa supporta più varianti robot, domini di progettazione operativa e modelli di business futuri. Si tratta di un ruolo senior e interfunzionale che spazia allo spettro tecnologico completo, dall'intelligenza artificiale e dall'autonomia attraverso hardware, software, meccatronica, sicurezza funzionale, integrazione di sistema e industrializzazione di fabbrica. Ti aiuterà a determinare come i nostri robot si evolvono da prodotti individuali forti in una famiglia scalabile di piattaforme, riutilizzo bilanciante, flessibilità, prestazioni, manufacturability e manutenbilità a lungo termine. Questo ruolo non riguarda solo il design tecnico. Si tratta anche di stabilire la direzione, guidare l'allineamento tra le squadre, e aiutare l'organizzazione a prendere forti decisioni architettoniche mentre scaleremo. Mercato e la nostra tecnologia ANYbotics è pioniera di piattaforme robotiche autonome per l'ispezione industriale e le operazioni in ambienti difficili. Dai sistemi a prova di esplosione in petrolio e gas alle piattaforme robotiche agili per le utility e altre impostazioni industriali, la nostra tecnologia è costruita per ambienti in cui la sicurezza, l'affidabilità e i tempi di avanzamento sono critici. L'Architettura di Sistema è centrale su come scalare. La sfida non è solo quella di costruire grandi robot, ma di creare l'architettura modulare, le interfacce e la strategia della piattaforma che permettono di derivare più varianti da un nucleo condiviso. Ciò include l'anticipazione delle future esigenze dei clienti, nuovi domini, requisiti di certificazione e integrazioni esterne come la gestione della flotta, la manutenzione predittiva e i gemelli digitali. descriptionByLocale.en:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As VP of System Architecture, you will define the architectural direction for the next generation of ANYbotics robot platforms. You will shape how a shared modular foundation supports multiple robot variants, operational design domains, and future business models.

This is a senior, cross-functional role spanning the full technology spectrum, from AI and autonomy through hardware, software, mechatronics, functional safety, system integration, and factory industrialization. You will help determine how our robots evolve from strong individual products into a scalable family of platforms, balancing reuse, flexibility, performance, manufacturability, and long-term maintainability.

This role is not just about technical design. It is also about setting direction, driving alignment across teams, and helping the organisation make strong architectural decisions as we scale.

Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is pioneering autonomous robotic platforms for industrial inspection and operations in challenging environments. From explosion-proof systems in oil and gas to agile robotic platforms for utilities and other industrial settings, our technology is built for environments where safety, reliability, and uptime are critical.

System Architecture is central to how we scale. The challenge is not only to build great robots, but to create the modular architecture, interfaces, and platform strategy that allow multiple variants to be derived from a shared core. This includes anticipating future customer needs, new domains, certification requirements, and external integrations such as fleet management, predictive maintenance, and digital twins.

With the right architecture in place, ANYbotics can move faster, reuse more effectively, and expand into new markets without rebuilding from scratch each time.

About us

ANYbotics is a leading robotics company specialising in advanced autonomous systems. With a successful Series B financing round closed and strong momentum in the market, we are entering an important phase of growth and international expansion.

Our mission is to transform industrial inspection and operations through world-class robotics. We combine deep robotics expertise with real customer deployments in demanding industrial environments. This is an opportunity to join at a stage where the technology is proven, the ambition is high, and the architectural decisions made now will have a major impact on the company’s future.

Your Contributions

•
Define and govern the reference system architecture across hardware and software domains focusing on modules interfaces

•
Build a modular platform strategy that enables multiple robot variants and operational domains to be derived from a shared architectural foundation

•
Drive architectural decisions on interfaces, middleware, data models, integration patterns, and the software backbone that supports future platform scaling

•
Define how reuse, configuration, and hardware-specific adaptation are handled so new variants can be developed without unnecessary redesign

•
Lead platform-level trade-offs across performance, agility, endurance, safety, manufacturability, and cost

•
Embed diagnostics, functional safety, cybersecurity, over-the-air updates, and certification requirements into the architecture from the outset

•
Partner with senior engineering leaders across software and hardware domains, and through the system engineering community to align on direction, influence execution, and translate long-term architecture into practical delivery

Your Profile

•
MSc in Systems Engineering, Electronics, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field

•
Significant experience in system architecture and modularity leadership within robotics, autonomous systems, medical devices, automotive, aerospace, or other complex mechatronic environments

•
Proven track record of architecting and evolving complex platforms rather than one-off systems

•
Experience defining modular architectures and enabling reuse across multiple product variants

•
Strong understanding of hardware and software co-design principles across sensors, actuators, compute, control systems, middleware, and power management

•
Good understanding of autonomy-related systems such as perception, localisation, navigation, motion planning, or fleet-level coordination

•
Experience with real-time systems, platform middleware, and system integration (V model) in complex industrial or safety-relevant environments

•
Ability to translate customer needs, business direction, and technical constraints into clear architectural decisions

•
Experience balancing performance, safety, manufacturability, scalability, and product maturity in real-world systems

•
Proven ability to influence across teams, drive alignment, and lead change without relying solely on formal authority

•
Strong communication and influence skills, sound judgement, and the ability to simplify complex architectural questions for a broad technical audience

•
Proven ability to translate company strategy and mid- to long-term technology vision into a clear, executable roadmap, along with effective governance to drive its execution.

Bonus Points

•
Experience with safety-critical or regulated robotic systems

•
Familiarity with Ex certification or related industrial safety constraints

•
Experience with large-scale simulation environments, digital twins, or platform-level validation frameworks

•
Track record of reducing time to market through platform reuse and stronger architectural discipline

•
Experience embedding certification and safety pathways into architectural frameworks

•
Experience supporting products that scale across multiple variants, deployment environments, or different operational design domains

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

You should be excited to work hands-on with physical robots, translate real-world field behaviour into reproducible tests and simulation scenarios, and build test infrastructure that the team can rely on for years.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. The Market & Our Technology

•
Design, build and maintain system-level and integration tests for the Motion Intelligence stack, enabling reliable release, regression and certification testing

Write clean and maintainable test code, primarily in Python, and help evolve our system-test infrastructure, testbeds and internal testing facilities

Define and maintain the Operational Design Domain for locomotion, translating environments such as stairs, ramps, tight spaces, dust, snow and mud into reproducible laboratory and simulation scenarios

•
Build test coverage across the software and mechatronic system, including drive behaviour, motion performance, middleware interfaces and new hardware or firmware configurations

•
Apply simulation and hardware-in-the-loop testing where they improve coverage, repeatability or development speed

Work closely with software, controls, hardware, systems and field engineering teams to raise the overall reliability and quality of the robot

Degree in robotics, mechatronics, computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or a related field

•

•
A systems-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand overall requirements and constraints while investigating problems in detail

•
Strong software fundamentals and proficiency in Python for test automation, data analysis and tooling, with working knowledge of C++

•
Experience working with Linux and ROS or ROS2, together with an understanding of middleware and interfaces within complex robotic systems

•
Experience designing, automating or maintaining system-level, integration or hardware-software tests

•
Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim to reproduce behaviour and build test scenarios

•
A structured, methodical and rigorous approach, with clear written and verbal communication skills in English

•
Field or deployment experience with robotic systems operating outside controlled laboratory environments

•
Experience working in industrial, energy, process or other safety-critical environments

•
Experience defining operational design domains, system limits, requirements or safety cases

•
Experience with continuous integration, hardware-in-the-loop testing, test automation frameworks or test-management tools such as Testmo

•
Familiarity with motors, drives, actuators, EtherCAT, embedded firmware, motion control or mechatronic verification

•
A track record of turning field failures into reproducible laboratory tests or simulation scenarios

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

descriptionByLocale.en:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As Senior Business Value Engineer, Oil & Gas, you will lead value engineering and customer success for strategic Oil & Gas accounts, with an immediate focus on Pre-Sales Value Engineering as ANYmal X launches.

This role is about helping customers move from early interest and evaluation to successful deployment, measurable business value and repeatable expansion. You will work closely with Sales, Solution Architects and Field Engineering to shape strong use cases, build credible business cases and help customers adopt the solution successfully.

The role is focused on customer value, stakeholder alignment and project success, not hardware troubleshooting or day-to-day field execution. You will act as a trusted advisor to customers and as the voice of the customer internally.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics brings robotics into industrial environments where safety, uptime and operational reliability matter most. Our customers are large asset operators and service providers using our solution for autonomous inspection and monitoring across sectors including oil and gas, chemicals, rail, wind energy, mining and construction.

Our offering combines the robot platform, inspection payloads, charging systems, autonomy and software into a complete inspection solution. We have proven both the technology and the customer value through long-term deployments and are now focused on scaling our products and platform globally.

Your Contributions

• Own strategic customer engagement in Oil & Gas: Act as a senior customer-facing advisor for strategic Oil & Gas accounts, helping define strong use cases and ensuring the solution is tied to clear business value.

• Support pre-sales value engineering: Partner with Sales and Solution Architects to build robust ROI models, business cases and deployment concepts that support successful deal progression.

• Scope deployments: Conduct site evaluations and work with customer stakeholders to ensure proposed deployments align with operational requirements, facility constraints and success criteria.

• Shape value realisation plans: Help define the project blueprint and Value Realization Plan, including use cases, applications, milestones and integration pathways needed to deliver measurable impact and create a path to expansion.

• Guide deployment and adoption: Support customers through deployment and adoption, helping maintain momentum, remove blockers and increase speed to value.

• Build stakeholder alignment: Build trusted relationships across customer organisations, from site teams and engineers to plant leadership and senior decision-makers.

• Bring customer insight back into the business: Work closely with Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to ensure customer feedback, deployment insight and emerging needs are reflected in how we evolve the product and broader offering.

• Support operational change: Help customers integrate robotics into their operations by aligning technical capability with business processes, stakeholder expectations and long-term success.

Your Profile

• Industry background: Significant Pre-Sales and/or Customer Success experience in Oil & Gas or a closely related industrial environment.

• Solution experience: Proven track record in selling, scoping or managing complex APM, industrial software, industrial IoT or robotics solutions.

• Business value focus: Able to build ROI cases and present business value credibly to plant leadership, operational stakeholders and senior decision-makers.

• Project leadership: Strong structured project management skills, including success plans, milestone tracking and cross-functional coordination.

• Stakeholder management: Comfortable working across Sales, technical teams and enterprise customer stakeholders in complex environments.

• Communication: Strong communicator who can engage credibly with a wide range of audiences, from site teams and engineers through to executives.

• Technical credibility: Engineering degree or comparable technical background, with enough technical grounding to work effectively across product, solution and deployment topics.

• Travel: Willingness to travel approx. 50% of time to customer sites to support strategic alignment and solution success.

Bonus Points

• Experience with industrial robotics, autonomous inspection or remote operations

• Familiarity with APM, industrial software or industrial IoT environments

• Industry knowledge in Chemicals or other process industries alongside Oil & Gas

• Technical familiarity with Linux, networking, ROS, Git, Python or similar tools

• German language skills

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary and an attractive employee stock ownership plan.
